variants.headline: Home world answers colony's petition
variants.body: The home world has answered the colony's petition. We stand with {target} against an easy verdict; a principled politics should also be a fair one.

variants.headline: A reply to the colonial petition

variants.headline: Petition receives an answer
variants.body: The colony has received an answer to its petition from the home world. We stand with {target} against an easy verdict; a principled politics should also be a fair one.
